statement: Privacy as exact combinatorics on synthetic data: k-anonymity over all 65536 four-row tables (largest k = 1, 2, 4 for 64800, 720, 16 tables) with the least-generalization search equal to brute force on every table; the exact distribution of unique individuals matches E = n(1-1/D)^(n-1) for 30 (n, D) pairs; randomized response meets epsilon-DP with ratio p/(1-p) over all 98 neighbour pairs, and sequential composition adds exactly; Bell and Stirling numbers by enumeration. Definitions on synthetic data, not a guarantee for any real release.
privacy.ath: the equality patterns of n table rows number B(n), the Bell numbers, for n=1..8, each term equal to the sum over k of S(n,k) computed exactly; biology/privacy/check.py passes.

core/ontology/joins/privacy_poetry.ath: equality patterns of n table rows (biology/privacy/fingerprints.json) and rhyme schemes of n lines (culture/poetry/fingerprints.json) agree on all 8 common terms, the Bell numbers 1, 2, 5, 15, 52, 203, 877, 4140; biology/privacy/check.py and culture/poetry/check.py both pass. Both are set partitions.
